findings.current: No. Looking would do him no good.
findings.defect: The source clarifies that he listened rather than merely looking; it does not say that looking would be useless. That added inference changes the thought’s emphasis.
findings.rationale: The Korean says, “아니, 정확히는 온 신경을 집중하여 귀를 기울였다,” a correction from looking around to concentrating on listening, not a judgment that looking would do no good.
findings.replacement: No—more precisely, he focused all his attention on listening.

findings.current: All that practice for two days straight paid off.
findings.defect: The narration omits that the intruder showed unmistakable delight and spoke triumphantly as he added this.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes 숨길 수 없는 기쁨 and 의기양양한 어조 before the intruder’s line. The current version preserves the spoken content but drops both the visible delight and the triumphant delivery.
findings.replacement: The intruder, unable to hide his delight, added triumphantly, “All that practice for two days straight paid off.”

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, but it adds an inference during the black-robed man’s search for a reply and omits a narrated emotional beat.
